caption: The drawing depicts a single duck in a side profile, facing left. The duck’s head is a deep reddish-brown color with a somewhat darker brown beak and a prominent, white-trimmed black marking running from the beak through the eye to the back of the head. The eye is round and light-colored with a black pupil. The duck's body has a speckled pattern of brown and tan on the breast and underbelly, while the rest of the body is rendered in shades of brown, with the feathers on the wings outlined in lighter hues. The wings also have small patches of dark green and hints of white and blue near the upper side. The background is plain and uncolored, leaving the duck as the sole object in the composition. There are no additional objects or scenery, and the overall style is simple and stylized, emphasizing patterns and color blocks.
title: Decoy Duck
